name: SplashCursor-TS-TW
title: Fluid Splash Cursor
blurb: Fluid ink simulation that responds to cursor movement and clicks.
description: Renders a fluid dynamics simulation on canvas using WebGL. Pointer movement creates velocity forces, clicks trigger colored splats. Simulates advection, pressure, curl forces with real-time solver.
use_when: Full-screen interactive art backgrounds or immersive hero sections that reward exploration.
avoid_when: Touch-only devices (no pointer); high-traffic pages (RAF loop uses significant GPU/CPU); requires a sized parent.
a11y: Canvas wrapper only; no keyboard interaction or prefers-reduced-motion support.
